input: Search all .js files under /src for the string 'console.log'. Replace every occurrence with 'logger.info' in-place. Print each modified filename and how many replacements were made per file. At the end, print 'Files modified: N' with the total count of files changed.

tool_calls:
for f in /src/*.js; do
  echo "=== $f ==="
  cat "$f"
done

# Test counting matches
for f in $(find /src -type f -name "*.js" | sort); do
  count=$(grep -o 'console\.log' "$f" | wc -l)
  echo "$f: $count"
done

# Revert /src/app.js to test our full script cleanly
sed -i 's/logger\.info/console\.log/g' /src/app.js
